title: Forgot Your Password?
status: rendered to Production Handoff standards (proof-of-concept tier)
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
activation_barrier: 'I can't even remember my login — it's a hassle.'
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.
distribution: Day-14 slot of the activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette

models.keyframes: nano_banana_pro (image, dual character reference: Victor + Goblin)

voiceover.line: Forget the passwords. Getting your accounts to Southwest Recovery Services is easier than you think. Just email info@swrecovery.com.
voiceover.spoken_as: the domain is read as 'info at S-W Recovery dot com' for a clean TTS read
voiceover.note: VO runs ~12.5s so total episode extended to 23s (brand card lengthened to 5s)

standards_deferred: Official SWRS logo-lockup animation — Branding stage.
production.audio_mix: DUCKING mix: scene SFX (goblin) plays at full level (1.0x) in scenes 1-2, ducks to 0.22x only during the scene-3 narration window (t=10.0-18.2s), then recovers; voiceover at 1.25x; amix normalize=0 + alimiter 0.95. Both the goblin SFX and the VO are clearly audible. This ducking mix is the standard for all future episodes.
production.logo_animation: official white SWRS logo (media 38707f0b) fades in top-center on the BRAND-CLOSE CARD ONLY (t=18.2s, 0.8s alpha fade, 520px, soft drop shadow). Standard: logo only in the last scene.
